say:1:1620803001:1.text: The library's haunted... I'm absolutely sure!
say:1:1620803001:1.source_cn: 图书馆里在闹鬼，绝对是这样……不会错的！

say:3:1620803002:0.text: That was scary... Why hasn't the school done anything? What if something terrible happens?
say:3:1620803002:0.source_cn: 太吓人了……校方没有派人出来管管吗？万一出了事怎么办？

say:5:1620803003:1.text: Calm down. Have you been reading too many horror novels? Enchanted things are everywhere on campus. You probably just saw a rogue one.
say:5:1620803003:1.source_cn: 冷静点。安塞尔，会不会是你想多了？这里可是莱希拉姆，说...

say:6:1620803004:1.text: No! What happened last night can't be explained by magic...
say:6:1620803004:1.source_cn: 不！这次肯定不是魔法。那天我在图书馆经历的事……完全无...

say:7:1620803005:1.text: Last night, I was revising for my alchemy test, but it didn't go well. I tried to memorize the recipes, and none of them stuck.
say:7:1620803005:1.source_cn: 昨天晚上，我正为炼金课程测试发愁。那么多配方，我一条都...

say:8:1620803006:1.text: Then I recalled a rumor that the professor often reuses the same set of questions, and that the answers could be found in a book at the library...
say:8:1620803006:1.source_cn: 不过我听说，教授喜欢重复用同一套考题；我又听说，考题的...

say:9:1620803007:1.text: You borrowed that legendary book?! No wonder you did so well on the test!
say:9:1620803007:1.source_cn: 你去借了那本宝贝书？！怪不得你这次考试成绩这么好，你小子——

say:10:1620803008:1.text: That's not the point! The problem is what happened afterward!
say:10:1620803008:1.source_cn: 咳咳！这不是重点，问题是在那之后发生的事！

say:11:1620803009:1.text: As everyone knows, going to the library after hours is against school rules, and violators lose half their holidays... but failing a course is far worse!
say:11:1620803009:1.source_cn: 按照校规，闭馆后进入图书馆必须接受惩罚，节假日会减半…...

say:12:1620803010:1.text: So, I decided to get the book. I slipped into the library through the side entrance while the guards weren't looking...
say:12:1620803010:1.source_cn: 打定主意后，我当晚就趁莱希拉姆守卫没注意，从侧门溜了进去……
